scripts.text:
delete from stg.csi_po_header;

insert into stg.csi_po_header
Select 
	site_ref
	,trim(po_num) po_num
	,dateadd(HOUR,2,cast(order_date as datetime)) order_date
	,po_cost
	,vend_num
	,trim(inv_num) inv_num
	,dateadd(HOUR,2,cast(inv_date as datetime)) inv_date
	,curr_code
	,exch_rate
	,dateadd(HOUR,2,cast(CreateDate as datetime)) CreateDate
	,dateadd(HOUR,2,cast(RecordDate as datetime)) RecordDate
	,stat
	,type
	,whse
	,DLDeleteIndicator
From raw.csi_po_mst;

delete from stg.csi_po_line;

insert into stg.csi_po_line
SELECT 

	site_ref
	,trim(po_num) po_num
	,po_line
	,item
	,description
	,vend_item
	,blanket_qty
	,blanket_qty_conv
	,item_cost
	,item_cost_conv
	,plan_cost
	,plan_cost_conv
	,unit_mat_cost
	,unit_mat_cost_conv
	,stat
	,u_m
	,dateadd(HOUR,2,cast(due_date as datetime)) due_date
	,dateadd(HOUR,2,cast(eff_date as datetime)) eff_date
	,dateadd(HOUR,2,cast(exp_date as datetime)) exp_date
	,dateadd(HOUR,2,cast(CreateDate as datetime)) CreateDate
	,dateadd(HOUR,2,cast(RecordDate as datetime)) RecordDate
	,DLDeleteIndicator
  FROM raw.csi_po_bln_mst;

delete from stg.csi_po_release;

insert into stg.csi_po_release
select 
	trim(po_num) po_num
	,po_line
	,po_release
	,site_ref
	,item
	,item_cost
	,plan_cost
	,po_vend_num
	,qty_ordered
	,qty_ordered_conv
	,qty_received
	,qty_rejected
	,qty_returned
	,dateadd(HOUR,2,cast(release_date as datetime)) release_date
	,dateadd(HOUR,2,cast(promise_date as datetime)) promise_date
	,dateadd(HOUR,2,cast(rcvd_date as datetime)) rcvd_date
	,dateadd(HOUR,2,cast(due_date as datetime)) due_date
	,dateadd(HOUR,2,cast(RecordDate as datetime)) RecordDate
	,dateadd(HOUR,2,cast(CreateDate as datetime)) CreateDate
	,u_m
	,whse
	,stat
	,DLDeleteIndicator
From raw.csi_poitem_mst;
